newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taiyo Yuden rises to life-time high.
newsitem.headline: Taiyo Yuden rises to life-time high.

text.p: Shares in Taiyo Yuden Co Ltd hit a new lifetime high on Tuesday, encouraged by solid earnings the firm announced last month, traders said.
The maker of electrolytic capacitors and ferrites briefly rose to an all-time high of 2,000 yen, having hit a previous high of 1,940 on Monday.
At 0115 GMT, the share was up 50 yen at 1,970. Turnover was 1.402 million shares.
On May 21, Taiyo Yuden said its parent current profits increased to 7.34 billion yen for the year to March 31, 1997, from 6.18 billion yen a year earlier.
The firm also said it expected its parent current profits to rise to 10 billion yen for 1997/98.
